input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position in full. § 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data and independently developed IP, with Vendor receiving only a limited processing right; § 14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable with an express Vendor assignment and further-assurances covenant; § 14.3 lets Vendor retain Vendor Technology but routes embedded Vendor Technology into the § 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business; and § 14.4 bars joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted rights. Nothing assigns our IP or data (including derived output, which is captured in the Customer Data definition) to Vendor, and § 15.1 blocks sale, advertising, data commingling and model training without our consent. Only minor points to note, not deviations: the Deliverable ownership is conditioned on payment of the applicable Fees, and the Customer Data definition carves out anonymized operational telemetry that cannot reasonably be linked to us or an individual — both are customary and within the preferred position.
